title: Offer the Payables Agent again in a company recreated with the same name
summary: The Payables Agent is now offered again in the plus menu when a company is recreated with the same name, by checking only the agent linked in the company setup instead of searching by user name.
key_points: Only the agent linked in the company's setup counts as set up for the plus menu and Purchase Invoices actions
Deleted companies keep their agent user, which previously made a recreated company with the same name look already set up
Setup still locates the existing agent by user name and reuses it, so no duplicate agent user is created
Setup, intake and upgrade find the agent as before
quote: Setup still finds the existing agent by user name and reuses it, so no second agent user is created.
